tasks.title: Lock the business clock, stock, queue and billing contracts
tasks.objective: Define the consumables, order queue, ready shelf, 24-hour clock, 30-day bills and balance before implementation.
acceptance: Consumable items, costs and capacities are explicit
Consumption and out-of-stock blocking rules are defined
Five active orders and ten ready orders are defined
Clock, billing cadence, grace and late-fee rules are defined
Task order and acceptance mapping are recorded

tasks.title: Add the business clock and day counter
tasks.objective: Provide a serializable Day 1+ 24-hour clock with real-time advance, deterministic advance and a skip-to-next-day action.
acceptance: Clock starts at Day 1 08:00 and rolls over at 24:00
Tick and AdvanceMinutes are deterministic in tests
SkipToNextDay reaches 08:00 the following day
Clock state is serializable

tasks.title: Add consumable shelves, restock purchases and stock state
tasks.objective: Add detergent, fragrance and plastic shelves with capacity 10, one-unit purchases at a fixed cost, and visible stock.
acceptance: One shelf exists per consumable and holds at most 10
Each interaction buys exactly one unit through EconomyService
A full shelf rejects the purchase without spending
Stock survives in serializable state

tasks.title: Consume stock in processing and block empty stages
tasks.objective: Make wash consume detergent, dry consume fragrance and wrap consume plastic; an empty shelf blocks the stage with a clear reason.
acceptance: Each stage consumes exactly one unit
An empty shelf blocks the stage and leaves the item unchanged
Restocking immediately unblocks the stage
The blocker is visible in the ticket or prompt

tasks.title: Raise the order queue to five active orders
tasks.objective: Let up to five orders be active at once with their own drop-off slots and customers, without breaking the single-order path.
acceptance: Five orders can be registered and active together
Customers do not overwrite each other's tickets or items
The single-order flow still works
The queue rejects a sixth active order with a clear reason

tasks.title: Add the ready-order shelf and ticket pickup
tasks.objective: Move wrapped parcels to a ten-slot ready shelf, let multiple orders be ready, and have the matching customer collect and pay by ticket.
acceptance: Up to ten wrapped orders can wait on the shelf
Multiple orders can be ready simultaneously
Each ticket pays exactly once when collected
A full shelf blocks wrapping with a clear reason

tasks.title: Add 30-day rent and utility billing with a bills menu
tasks.objective: Generate an itemized rent/electricity/water bill every 30 days, allow payment from a menu, and keep an unaffordable bill recoverable.
acceptance: A bill is generated at day 30 and every 30 days after
Rent, electricity and water are separate line items
Paying debits once and closes the bill
An unaffordable bill stays open; the wallet never goes negative
A 10% late fee applies once after three days

tasks.title: Surface clock, stock, queue and bills in the HUD
tasks.objective: Make the business state readable without opening the scene: day/time, stock counts, active/ready orders and the next bill.
acceptance: HUD shows day/time, stock per item, active/ready counts and next bill
Bills menu opens and closes with a key
HUD stays hidden during the arcade session and pause
Text is readable at 1920x1080

tasks.title: Balance and verify the combined stock/queue/bill loop
tasks.objective: Prove the loop scales, stays recoverable and cannot duplicate money across five orders, stock and bills.
acceptance: Long session: stock -> five orders -> ready shelf -> payments -> 30-day bill
Stock-out and bill-out states are recoverable
Exactly-once payment still holds
Suite totals and balance placeholders are recorded

tasks.title: Owner playtest and Phase 10 closeout
tasks.objective: Verify the stock, queue, ready shelf and bill loop is coherent and recoverable, then record completion.
acceptance: Owner plays a session that runs out of stock and pays a bill
Result recorded in a report
Phase 10 marked complete and tagged
